title: Daemon: writes survive a failed refresh, dash-leading slicer values, vendor note sentences
lead: *Proposed.* A daemon write that succeeded reports success even when the refresh after it fails. ork passes free text to slicer attached to its flag (`--text=TEXT`), so a single word that starts with a dash is not read as a flag. The run plan's vendor note gives each out vendor its own sentence. The CLI's empty-note message names the argument.
findings_note: 2026-11-17: re-verified at HEAD f48a6154. adj.answer and adj.ask return the refresh error after a successful write, and so do item.new, item.park, item.unpark and item.move; slicer note, edit and relay-run ask still pass free text as a separate argument; the plan note joins two out vendors with "; "; the CLI says "note: Note must not be empty". relay.answer is already fixed.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Daemon and CLI half of the S227 notes row. Re-verified at HEAD `f48a6154`:

- S194 new item, refresh-after-write (still present, more sites). `item.note` treats the refresh as freshness only (`internal/daemon/items.go:47-49`), and `relay.answer` appends `; refresh failed: ...` and still succeeds (`internal/daemon/relayanswer.go:115-118`; fixed). Still returning the refresh error after the write: `adj.answer` (`internal/daemon/adjwrite.go:30-32`), `adj.ask` (`adjwrite.go:52-54`), `item.new` (`internal/daemon/items.go:66-68`), `item.park` (`items.go:86-88`), `item.unpark` (`items.go:123-125`) and `item.move` (`items.go:149-151`). The client sees a failure for a write that happened; a retry of `adj ask` or `item.new` can write twice.
- S194 new item, dash-leading values (still present). `Note` passes `"--text", text` (`internal/slicercli/write.go:201`), `EditAppend` (`write.go:459`) and `EditReplaceArgs` (`write.go:467`) the same, and `RelayAsk` passes `"--title", q.Title` and `"--option", LABEL:SUMMARY` (`write.go:524,529`). slicer defines these with argparse (`slicer/src/slicer/cli_parser.py:604,632,1090,1092`), which reads a separate value that starts with a dash as an option. `relay-run answer` and `relay-roles` already attach their values (`write.go:563-565`, `write.go:268-272`). `docs/dashboard.md:2273-2275` says `ork note P S12 -- "-x"` works as typed; it reaches slicer as `--text -x`.
- S169 item 6 (still present). `vendorNote` joins one note per out vendor with `"; "` (`internal/daemon/vendors.go:110-115`), and each note already holds `; ` twice, so two vendors read as one run-on list.
- S171 item 4 (still present). `ork note` prints `note: Note must not be empty` (`internal/cli/note.go:41`); the error text of `slicercli.Note` is `Note must not be empty` (`write.go:199`).

Owner decisions (2026-11-17): a write whose refresh fails returns its result silently, as `item.note` does (adj 435).

Not in this slice: `slicer add TITLE` (`write.go:495`), a positional that cannot be attached; any TUI change. The TUI's own `Note must not be empty` status (`internal/tui/compose.go:114`) is a sentence start and stays.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestAdjWritesSucceedWhenTheRefreshFails` (`internal/daemon/adjwrite_test.go`): the daemon of `TestAdjMethodsDecideAskAndRefresh`, then `d.cache.Close()` as in `TestItemNoteSucceedsWhenTheItemsRefreshFails`. `adj.answer` returns its result message with a nil error; `adj.ask` returns `{"id":N}` with a nil error; the fake adj saw exactly one write each. Fails first: both return the closed-cache error.
- `TestItemWritesSucceedWhenTheRefreshFails` (`internal/daemon/items_test.go`): table over `item.new`, `item.park`, `item.unpark`, `item.move` with the slicer routes of their existing tests and a closed cache. Each returns its normal result and nil. Fails first: each returns the refresh error.
- `TestSlicerFreeTextIsAttachedToItsFlag` (`internal/slicercli/write_test.go`): table. `Note(..., "S04", "-x")` runs `note S04 --text=-x --render --json --root WT`; `EditAppend(..., "S1", "Why", "-x")` runs `edit S1 --section Why --append --text=-x --render --json --lean --root WT`; `EditReplaceArgs("S1", "Why", "-x")` is `[edit S1 --section Why --text=-x]`; `RelayAsk` with title `-t` and option `-a`/`-s` has `--title=-t` and `--option=-a:-s`. Fails first: each passes the value as its own argument.
- Existing tests whose expected argv changes to the attached form, same names: `TestItemNoteWritesTheNoteAndReadsItemsAgain` (`--text=- text`), the `write_test.go` note cases (`:296,302,327`), `add_test.go:64`, `editreplace_test.go:15,27`, and the `RelayAsk` cases (`write_test.go:454-455,470-471`).
- `TestPlanNoteGivesEachOutVendorASentence` (`internal/daemon/vendors_test.go`): codex marked out by an exit and grok by the owner. `plan.Note` contains `; ork vendor back codex ends it. grok is out until back` (vendors in `vendorsOut` order) and does not contain `ends it; `. With one vendor out the note is as today (the existing `TestPlanNotesAVendorThatIsOut` keeps passing). Fails first: the join is `; `.
- `TestNoteRefusesAnEmptyTextByItsArgumentName` (`internal/cli/note_test.go`): `ork note p S1 "  "` exits 2 and stderr contains `note: TEXT must not be empty` and not `Note must`. Fails first: the message is `note: Note must not be empty`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Tests first, then:

1. `adjwrite.go` and `items.go`: after a successful write, `_ = d.cache.Refresh(...)` with the comment `// The write is done; the refresh is only freshness.`, as `itemNote` does. Keep every check before the write as it is.
2. `slicercli/write.go`: `"--text="+text` in `Note`, `EditAppend` and `EditReplaceArgs`; `"--title="+q.Title` and `"--option="+o.Label+":"+o.Summary` in `RelayAsk`. `Note`'s error becomes `note text must not be empty`. Update the doc comments that show the argv.
3. `vendorNote`: join the notes with `". "`; a single note is unchanged. Leave the join with an earlier `plan.Note` (`runs.go:734-739`) as it is.
4. `internal/cli/note.go:41`: `note: TEXT must not be empty`.
5. Docs: `docs/design.md`, where the slicer write calls are listed, says ork attaches free-text values (`--text=TEXT`, `--title=`, `--option=`) so a leading dash stays text (*proposed*). `docs/dashboard.md:2273-2275`: keep the example; it now holds.
6. CHANGELOG.md: one new bullet at the end of `## Unreleased`: daemon writes report success when only the refresh fails; free text that starts with a dash reaches slicer as text; the plan note gives each out vendor its own sentence; `ork note` names TEXT when it is empty (S227).
7. UI slice: UI pass (r14), because the CLI output and the plan note change.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:

- 'adj.answer', 'adj.ask', 'item.new', 'item.park', 'item.unpark' and 'item.move' return their result, not an error, when the write succeeds and the refresh fails.
- 'ork note P ITEM -- -x' reaches slicer as 'note ITEM --text=-x'; the same holds for edit text and relay-run ask title and options.
- With two vendors out, the plan note shows two sentences, one per vendor.
- 'ork note P S1 ""' prints 'note: TEXT must not be empty'.

Commands:

- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...` exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.
- `rg -n '"--text", text|"--title", q\.Title|"--option", o\.Label' internal/slicercli` prints nothing.
- `rg -n 'Note must not be empty' internal/cli internal/slicercli` prints nothing.
- `rg -n 'return nil, err' -B1 internal/daemon/adjwrite.go | rg 'cache.Refresh'` prints nothing.
